title: Sparse MLLM Anchors, Dense Adaptation: Breaking the Self-Referential Loop in Wild Test-Time Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2609.17040v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Wild test-time adaptation (WTTA) updates a source model online under small test batches, concurrent distribution shifts, and time-varying class imbalance. Most WTTA methods derive their adaptation signals, including predictive uncertainty, sample reliability, and local feature geometry, from the model being adapted. When the source model is unreliable under shift, these signals can reinforce its own errors, forming a self-referential loop. We introduce MASA (Multimodal-LLM-Anchored Semantic Adaptation), which complements model-internal evidence with structured semantic descriptions from a frozen multimodal large language model (MLLM). To limit inference cost, MASA queries the MLLM only for a small set of diverse, reliability-ranked anchors. The resulting descriptions capture the object family and nuisance factors such as style, viewpoint, and occlusion. translated_title: 稀疏MLLM锚点与密集自适应：打破野外测试时自适应中的自指循环
translated_abstract: 野外测试时自适应（WTTA）需要在小型测试批次、并发分布偏移和时变类别不平衡的条件下在线更新源模型。大多数WTTA方法的自适应信号——包括预测不确定性、样本可靠性和局部特征几何——均来自被适配的模型本身。当源模型在分布偏移下不可靠时，这些信号可能会强化模型自身的错误，形成自指循环。我们提出了MASA（多模态大语言模型锚定的语义自适应），它利用冻结的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）生成的结构化语义描述来补充模型内部证据。为限制推理成本，MASA仅对一小部分多样化且按可靠性排序的锚点样本查询MLLM。所得描述能够捕获目标类别族以及风格、视角和遮挡等干扰因素。MASA对这些描述进行编码，并将其传播到邻近的测试样本。
tldr: 该论文提出MASA方法，仅对少量按可靠性排序的锚点样本查询冻结的多模态大语言模型获取结构化语义描述，并将其密集传播到邻近测试样本，从而打破野外测试时自适应中模型依赖自身信号的错误自指循环。
en_tdlr: MASA breaks the self-referential loop in wild test-time adaptation by querying a frozen multimodal LLM only for sparse, reliability-ranked anchor samples and densely propagating their structured semantic descriptions to neighboring test samples.
